testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and dismisses quick access command choices ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is selected ✔ And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon ✔ When the user opens the quick access toolbar customization menu ✔ Then the menu lists New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Home, Projects, Update, Select, Refine Appearance, Material Browser, Materials, Appearance Browser, Appearance Override, Adjust, Clear, Parameters, Design Doctor, Print, iProperties, Return, and Measure ✔ And each listed command displays its current checked or unchecked state ✔ And the menu offers Show Below the Ribbon ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the customization menu closes ✔ And the command check states remain unchanged ✔ And the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
